entities.summary: Takayoshi Ohmura (b. 1983-12-23, Osaka) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Osaka and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, composers & musicians, asia.
